### 4. Scored parameters
**(a) Food-loss payment on 3bce4fe5 (pay_food_loss_claim).** Computation doc "Food-Loss Payment on … Standard Plans": latest food-loss claim (3bce4fe5, 312.40); per-claim limit = tier maximum $250.00; remaining share 2999.99 − 86.40 = 2913.59 — fall-back 250.00. Factors:

- 295.54 ≤ 2913.59 → **295.54**.

**(b) Standard cancellation refund (cancel_standard_plan).** Price kept 269.00. Factors:
- Manufacturer-warranty unused share — line warranty 12 < 36; whole months 2026-01-24 → 2026-10-23 = 8; excess 0 → unused share 1 (base would be 823/1096).
- Warranty-period cancellation fee — 8 whole months < 12 warranty months → no fee (base $25.00).
- Claims deduction — only food-loss payments booked (86.40 + 295.54) → one half = −190.97.
- Claim-handling charge — 4 claims filed → −$15.00.
- Price-drop rebate — Northgate price drop 100.00 on line amount 2999.99 → +269 × 100 / 2999.99 = +8.9667.
- Waiting addition — still-submitted request recorded 2026-10-05, 18 days (14–44) → +4 %.
- 269 × 1 − 0 = 269; −190.97 −15 +8.9667 = 71.9967; ×1.04 = 74.8766; ≤ 269; round down → **74.87**, basis **prorated_unused_days**, original_event_id 93a1c08f-….
- Fall-back: 269 × 823/1096 − 25.00 = 176.995 → 176.99 (≠ 74.87).
